commentary: A sharp distribution day in the Nifty 50 (-1.07%) and Sensex (-1.17%) triggered our CAUTION gate, with market breadth deteriorating to a defensive 48 score. In accordance with O'Neil's market direction tenets and Stan Weinstein's Stage discipline, general market pullbacks dictate defensive posture and progressive exposure curtailment. Even though selective pockets like Defence and Capital Goods show relative strength, broad institutional selling warns against aggressive position sizing. Minervini discipline mandates buying only pristine pivots with confirmed volume support while aggressively cutting losses on any setup failure. We strictly enforce CANSLIM earnings acceleration screens: candidates showing decelerating earnings or contracting revenues are restricted to Watch status, keeping capital reserved exclusively for genuine Stage 2 leaders.
